name: Sadistik Exekution
description: '''Sadistik Exekution''' was an Australian [[extreme metal]] band from [[Sydney]]. The band formed in 1985, and was mainly active from 1986 until 2004. Known for their live shows and non-conformism, Sadistik Exekution wrote, recorded and performed extreme death metal. The band members have stated they should not be confused labelled as "black metal". The band influenced some early Scandinavian black metal bands, and other extreme metal bands from around the world. Their last official live show was in Sydney in 1999, but reunited in November 2009, to perform as the main act at the first annual Australian Metal Awards in Sydney.
